_description: ElevenLabs TTS /v1/history export → AKSI control ID mapping. ElevenLabs is the dominant text-to-speech provider for voice agents; voice cloning + custom voice IDs introduce identity-impersonation, consent, and exfiltration risks that no other LLM-side importer captures. Each history item becomes one EvaluationResult covering: (1) voice provenance (premade vs cloned vs professional vs generated), (2) consent recording for cloned voices, (3) high-impact voice creation actions (voice_clone / voice_design), (4) speech-to-speech voice transformation, (5) shared audio links (exfil surface), (6) over-generation (large text-to-speech corpus dumps as a covert exfil channel), (7) failures.
